message.content: I usually wake up around seven, maybe a bit later some days. I make a cup of tea and have some toast, then feed the cat before leaving. I take the bus to work, so I leave home about half an hour before my shift starts. I work part time in a bookshop, so I don’t get there too early. Most days are pretty routine. I don’t mind the quiet morning, actually—it helps me feel more in control. I sometimes hear a voice when I’m alone, but that’s not every day. It’s more like… occasional. I don’t know what it means, but it doesn’t happen when I’m busy.
